title: Freeze Focus Dance
shareTitle: Freeze Focus Dance — Dance, Freeze, and Find
description: Dance with Pip in a clay forest, then freeze when the music stops. Choose Beat Stop, find a hidden forest friend in Owl Lookout, or copy a playful pose in Star Statues. Optional camera motion adds local sparkles but never judges or gates play.
learningGoals: Practice stopping the body on a spoken signal
Build impulse control and body-stop regulation
Sustain attention during a short still moment
Release energy through joyful whole-body movement
interactionModel: choose one of three timed dance-and-freeze modes; optionally enable local motion sparkles, then follow spoken cues, tap a discovered forest friend, or copy a modeled statue
feedbackModel: recorded narrator cues, authored freeze and forest visuals, dance music, tactile pop/sparkle/tada SFX, and mode-specific celebrations affirm movement and stillness without scoring or penalties

modes.title: Beat Stop
modes.skill: inhibit movement after an audio cue

modes.title: Star Statues
modes.skill: deliberately shape and hold the body

privacy.camera: optional local motion only; no recording, recognition, persistence, or upload
